patch_description: Add a one-pass robust reweighting step to the causal quadratic endpoint fit. The initial fit still captures genuine local curvature, then residual-based Huber weights limit leverage from impulsive samples. When the newest samples oppose both the fitted local slope and the tracker velocity, they receive a tighter clipping threshold. This specifically prevents isolated endpoint spikes from producing large innovations and false direction changes, while sustained reversals retain influence because multiple coherent counter-trend samples are not all rejected. The additional matrix solve is only 3x3 per window and keeps latency low.
